title: Update Application
description: Rename a custom application or change its address. Changing the address always opens a Confirm sheet, because saved accounts sign in on that address. Platform template applications cannot be changed.

inputSchema.description: Rename a custom application or change its address. Changing the address always opens a Confirm sheet, because saved accounts sign in on that address. Platform template applications cannot be changed.

appId.description: Opaque application reference returned by accounts.options.get.

patch.description: Application changes; omitted fields retain their values.

address.description: Absolute HTTP(S) homepage URL, without embedded username or password. Stored as application metadata, never used as an API endpoint.

outputSchema.description: Account operation result. status/stage are for internal reconciliation, not user-facing open-success/failure badges. Report the separate autofill receipt; a page being open never proves fill or sign-in.

autofill.description: Separate sign-in receipt: the DSphere account manager signs in on the opened page. Query accounts.operations.get with operationId while running; unknown must not be replayed. succeeded: the sign-in form was sent and the page no longer asks to sign in. skipped with already-signed-in, no-sign-in-form or site-unreachable (the tab shows the browser's error page): nothing was typed.

reason.description: Safe reason code; never credentials or page field values.

operationId.description: Local operation reference; not a Pangu request receipt.

stage.description: Completed or current account business stage.

pageContextId.description: Actual opened/focused page reference when known.

warnings.description: Bounded warnings, including synchronization and unknown outcomes.

data.description: Only the selected account operation's public product fields.

application.description: Verified custom application. Use appId with options.get and create, including when it has no accounts.

guidance:
Rename or re-address only on user intent, using appId from accounts.options.get. A name-only change is direct. An address change always opens a confirmation in the DSphere SidePanel, because saved accounts sign in on that address.

After an unknown outcome, read accounts.application.get; never replay the update.
